name: codexbox
description: OpenAI Codex CLI running in a Docker container, put on the network — a REST API, an OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint, an MCP server, a Telegram bot, and a cron scheduler.

url.title: codexbox URL
url.description: Base URL of your running codexbox server, e.g. http://localhost:8080 (same value as the OpenClaw bridge's CODEXBOX_URL).

api_token.title: codexbox API token
api_token.description: Bearer token for the REST/OpenAI-compatible surface. Only needed if the server was started with CODEXBOX_API_MODE_TOKEN set.

mcp_token.title: codexbox MCP token
mcp_token.description: Bearer token for the MCP surface. Only needed if the server was started with CODEXBOX_MCP_MODE_TOKEN set — independent from the API token, no fallback.
